clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonewatch Falls, water pours from Lake Everstill into a pool claimed by murlocs. The falls lie beneath Stonewatch in the eastern Redridge Mountains.

Stonewatch Falls rushes down the slope beneath Stonewatch, the Blackrock orc stronghold. Its water flows from Lake Everstill’s eastern river and gathers in a deep pool against the mountainside. Murlocs have claimed the shore, raising crude reed hovels and preying on travelers who come too close to the water.
